$comment: RasanAI's "What are you making?" picker: the single source of truth for the console, Studio and the Director. Tiles are what the user picks; each option sets the route, the source mode and case (scripts/lib/sources.mjs), the inputs to ask for, the research, the story pass and the allowed story shapes (ranked: Sure, Bold, Wild take the first three), the claim scope and the default length and aspect. status: ready (works today) | partial (works, its own shape or check is still being built: say so) | soon (not built: say so, offer `soon.nearest`, never route it quietly). Copy is shown to users: plain words. Read with scripts/formats.mjs (list, match, resolve, check). Research: .context/night/S2-formats.md (formats) and S1-video-types-stories.md (shapes, scope).

ladder.title: Refrain ladder
ladder.line: One verb repeats; each step is a different real use, rising from simple to done-for-you.

pas.title: Problem, then the fix
pas.line: The viewer's pain, the product arrives, two to four benefits, proof, a clear call to action.

scenario.title: One hero demo
scenario.line: One real task done start to finish: before, the task in the real product, after.

intercut.title: Parallel uses
intercut.line: Several people in different parts of life hit the same problem; the product solves each.

montage.title: Montage of range
montage.line: Six to twelve quick shots, each a different output or person, on the beat, then the claim.

hero-strip.title: Hero plus range strip
hero-strip.line: One convincing demo, then a fast strip of four to eight other uses.

before-after.title: Before and after
before-after.line: Paired lines or pictures: how it was, how it is now.

claim-ladder.title: Claim ladder
claim-ladder.line: Four to six claims, each proved by a demo from a different area of life.

manifesto.title: Manifesto
manifesto.line: A belief, people living it, the brand as the enabler, a sign-off.

life-arc.title: Life arc
life-arc.line: One person over months or years, each step a different use, ending on something everyone feels.

day-in-life.title: Day in the life
day-in-life.line: Morning to evening, a different moment at each step.

what-if.title: What if
what-if.line: A question, an imagined world, then: it's real now.

countdown.title: Countdown or teaser
countdown.line: A motif, partial reveals, the date.

testimony.title: Testimony
testimony.line: Who I am, how it was, the turning point, the result with a number, my line.

roundup.title: Roundup
roundup.line: A title card per item, the same grammar each time, then a finale.

strategic.title: Big change
strategic.line: The world is changing, who wins and loses, the promised land, the proof.

data-journey.title: Data journey
data-journey.line: A question, the numbers revealed in rising order, what they mean for people.

steps.title: Steps
steps.line: The goal, steps one to N, the result.

abt.title: And, but, therefore
abt.line: How things are, the snag, so here is what changes.

titles.title: Titles
titles.line: Set the mood, one credit per beat, then the title.

process.title: Process
process.line: How it's made: the raw start, the work, the finished thing.

acts.title: Acts
acts.line: A documentary in acts: the setup, the struggle, the resolution.

trailer.title: Trailer
trailer.line: The setup, the stakes, the best moment, the title and the date.

tiles.title: Launch or promo
tiles.description: Show off your product, app or site with its real screens.
tiles.thumbnail: A real app window glides in on a soft glow; one word of a headline highlights; a button pulses "Get it".

tiles.title: Explainer
tiles.description: Explain an idea, a process or the numbers, with animated visuals.
tiles.thumbnail: A dot becomes a diagram: three icons connect with lines; a chart bar grows; a label pops.

tiles.title: Brand film
tiles.description: A film about who you are, in your own colours, type and voice.
tiles.thumbnail: Big type re-divides a grid in brand colours; a cut-out photo slides into a cell; the logo lands.

tiles.title: Short animation
tiles.description: One short animated piece, under 15 seconds.
tiles.thumbnail: A logo sting: a circle squashes, bounces and becomes a mark, with a tiny flash.

tiles.title: Music video
tiles.description: A video for your song: the lyrics, the beat or the performance.
tiles.thumbnail: Lyric words appear on beat hits over a shifting colour plate; a waveform ticks along the bottom.

tiles.title: Reel from my clips
tiles.description: Turn a folder of clips into a reel cut to music, with titles and captions.
tiles.thumbnail: Phone clips snap into a vertical frame on beats; a bold caption word pops; a card "Lisbon, day 3" wipes in.

tiles.title: Someone talking
tiles.description: Make a talking video clear and watchable: captions, cuts and graphics.
tiles.thumbnail: A talking head; a name bar slides in; captions word by word; a key-point card appears beside them.

tiles.title: Customer or team story
tiles.description: Real people in their own words: customers, staff, the community.
tiles.thumbnail: An interview in warm light; a lower third "Maya, founder"; the proof number "3x" lands as a card.

tiles.title: Social ad
tiles.description: A scroll-stopping vertical ad: a hook, one benefit, proof, the offer.
tiles.thumbnail: A phone frame: a creator's face, a bold hook caption, a product close-up, a "Use code SPRING" sticker.

tiles.title: Screen recording
tiles.description: Polish a screen recording: cut the waiting, zoom on clicks, smooth the cursor.
tiles.thumbnail: A desktop recording zooms to a click with a ripple, pans to the next field, zooms back out.

tiles.title: Re-cut a video I have
tiles.description: Shorter, taller or translated versions of a video you've already made.
tiles.thumbnail: One wide frame splits into 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 versions; a "15s" badge flips to "6s".

tiles.title: Something else
tiles.description: Describe it in your own words.
tiles.thumbnail: A blinking cursor in a text box.
